name: Nobu Dubai (Atlantis The Palm)
questions: Do you have gluten-free soy sauce or tamari, and GF teriyaki?
Can you adapt (G)-tagged signatures such as the yellowtail jalapeno (yuzu-soy) or black cod with GF ingredients?
Is the sushi rice seasoned with plain rice vinegar or with anything containing malt or barley?
Are the new-style sashimi oil and the dressings soy-based?
quinoa_oat_flags: None found on the menus I saw, but check salads

safe_dishes.dish: Dishes with no (G) tag on the official menu
safe_dishes.note: The Atlantis menu uses (G) for gluten. Choose untagged dishes and confirm with your server.

safe_dishes.dish: Sashimi and plain nigiri with GF soy sauce
safe_dishes.note: The usual GF base, if they bring GF soy sauce.

summary: Celiac diners on FindMeGlutenFree report knowledgeable staff and careful handling, and the official menus tag gluten with (G). Many signature dishes are tagged, though, so you'll need modifications.
tamari_source: The official Atlantis menus tag gluten with '(G)' but don't mention tamari. FindMeGlutenFree Dubai lists Nobu under 'gluten-free soy sauce'. A celiac reviewer there says staff knew what could be made GF and took 'extreme care' with cross-contamination. A separate FMGF Nobu review mentions GF soy sauce and GF teriyaki, but its location is unclear.
